sara: Quick consolidation from the postmortem: tracking remediation owners for missing spans, aggregation skew, and ETL lag. Please ack and update ETA/test-plan inline.

sara: Actions list:
- R1 span-drop exporter hardening -> @ajay -> ETA 2025-05-08 -> INF-4600
- R2 aggregation null-key handling + tests -> @maria -> ETA 2025-04-29 -> INF-4601
- R3 ETL backfill + alert tuning -> @tim -> ETA 2025-05-13 -> DATA-800
- R4 golden-trace smoke for CI -> @lex -> ETA 2025-05-04 -> ADD-1000
- R5 pre-deploy checklist for high-cardinality jobs -> @oliver -> ETA 2025-05-18 -> OPS-220

ajay: ack. INF-4600: adding per-batch seq id, exporter queue metrics, and a circuit-breaker. Canary planned next Tue.

maria: ack. INF-4601: patch submitted that treats serialized nulls as explicit null and adds reduce-stage guard. running integration with 1M keys.

tim: ack. DATA-800: backfill job draft and new alert: partition_lag_seconds > 1800 for 15m -> page. Filing infra quota subtask.

lex: ack. golden-trace: 1k spans/service daily, mismatch threshold 3%, fail CI if exceeded. schema posted in ticket.

oliver: ack. checklist will include high-cardinality run at 1.5x QPS and shard-boundary checks.

srebot: Reminder: Postmortem INC-2025-03-12 accepted. Owners must update tickets within 72h.

sara: Scheduling a 20min sync Thu to unblock owners only. If all ETAs updated by EOD tomorrow we can cancel. Next step: owners, please put one-line test plan in ticket. Thanks!
